message: Astra: You noticed an “issue with the code formatting and variable names”; within your bulk-update project, what deserves more attention now: repairing that setup or obtaining evidence about the intended gradient? Why would additional thinking be worth its time compared with an informative attempt here, and what unresolved uncertainty could make thinking first more valuable? What evidence would justify your choice, and what next step will you choose and carry out rather than announce again?
